stories.label: Iran-US-Israel-Gulf war: UAE under attack, war now regional
stories.summary: Day 24. War expands to UAE — missiles and drones hitting Emirati territory for first time. Iranian families burying war dead in Tehran as wartime nationalism overrides regime opposition. Gulf regional conflagration now reality.

stories.label: Hormuz crisis: Sri Lanka/Thailand rationing fuel, Asian economies buckling
stories.summary: Economic contagion deepening: Sri Lanka and Thailand now formally rationing fuel. India negotiated tanker passage through Hormuz. Middle East oil benchmarks broken — Dubai premium at $56/barrel vs 90 cents in February. Pakistan exporters facing ad hoc cargo surcharges. Crisis spreading from markets to households. Indonesia now publicly reassuring 280M citizens fuel will last through Eid — 28 days of reserves. Zero ships crossed Hormuz on Saturday for first time.

stories.label: Lebanon-Israel-Palestine: Al-Aqsa closed indefinitely, 850K+ displaced
stories.summary: IDF ground operations in southern Lebanon. 850K+ displaced. Gaza invisible war continues — BBC documents 12-year-old boy testimony of family killed in car. Al-Aqsa closed through Eid.

stories.label: US-China: Xi-Trump summit planned end of March, Paris talks underway
stories.summary: Bessent-He Lifeng talks in Paris ahead of end-of-March summit. Trump now tying summit to China helping break Hormuz blockade. Not directly covered this cycle.

stories.label: Egypt: inflation, currency collapse, Suez revenue loss
stories.summary: Mada Masr analysis of Egyptian state response to overlapping crises. Not covered this cycle.

stories.label: Pakistan-Afghanistan cross-border strikes
stories.summary: Major escalation: Pakistan strikes Afghan Taliban military installations in Kabul and Nangarhar — hitting the capital itself, far beyond border area operations in Khost. Exploiting Iran war attention vacuum.

stories.label: Ecuador deploys 75,000 in largest anti-gang operation
stories.summary: Ecuador deploys 75,000 troops and police against drug gangs. Not covered this cycle.

stories.label: Oral GLP-1 pill shows significant weight loss
stories.summary: Structure Therapeutics oral GLP-1 reports significant weight loss. Not covered this cycle.

stories.label: TikTok and Meta whistleblowers: algorithm arms race sacrificed safety
stories.summary: Multiple whistleblowers say TikTok and Meta deliberately weakened safety for engagement. Not covered this cycle.

stories.label: Sudan: RSF drone terror + military integration push
stories.summary: RSF losing territory (Bara retaken) but escalating with drone terror targeting homes, markets, hospitals in Kordofan/Blue Nile. Military moving to integrate all armed groups — Juba Peace Agreement signatories fear loss of leverage. War shifting from ground combat to aerial psychological attrition.

stories.label: Nepal: First transgender woman lawmaker
stories.summary: Bhumika Shrestha, 37, becomes Nepal's first transgender woman MP via proportional representation from the RSP majority party (182 seats). Nepal has one of South Asia's most progressive LGBTQ frameworks.

stories.label: India: Odisha hospital ICU fire kills 10
stories.summary: 10 killed in ICU fire in Cuttack, Odisha from electrical short circuit. Short circuits are leading cause of building fires in India — systemic safety enforcement failure.

stories.label: Kenya-Russia: Moscow agrees to stop recruiting Kenyans for Ukraine war
stories.summary: 1,000+ Kenyans recruited to fight for Russia in Ukraine. FM Mudavadi says Moscow agreed to stop. Enforceability unclear — recruitment operated through informal brokers.

stories.label: Sarkozy appeals Libya campaign funding conviction
stories.summary: Sarkozy appealing conviction for Gaddafi-funded 2007 campaign. Served 20 days in prison in 2025. Took Libyan money, then helped destroy the Libyan state in 2011.

stories.label: Uganda public debt crosses $35 billion
stories.summary: Uganda debt at $35bn — roughly $800 per citizen in a country with ~$960 GDP per capita. Infrastructure borrowing while Hormuz crisis complicates nascent oil sector.

stories.label: Trump FCC threatens broadcasters over war coverage
stories.summary: FCC chair threatened to cancel spectrum permits of broadcasters over 'negative' Iran war coverage. Weaponizing telecom regulation for political censorship during wartime.

stories.label: Humanoid robots still can't do fine motor tasks
stories.summary: Despite vast improvements in locomotion, humanoid robots still can't reliably perform fine motor tasks a toddler masters by age 2. May require fundamentals rethink.

stories.label: Bangladesh lost $1.8B to digital scams over 15 years
stories.summary: Home minister disclosed $1.8B lost to digital scams 2006-2021. Mobile banking adoption outpaced fraud prevention, hitting low-income users hardest.

stories.label: Germany barely meets 2025 climate target amid government rift
stories.summary: Germany scraped its 2025 climate target but progress came partly from deindustrialization. Coalition rift over next steps as Hormuz crisis gives climate skeptics new ammunition.

stories.label: ICC governing body rules on Karim Khan misconduct
stories.summary: 21-member Bureau of Assembly of States Parties to rule on misconduct claims against ICC Prosecutor who issued warrants for Israeli/Hamas leaders and was building Iran war cases.

stories.label: Circle/USDC surges as war-era parallel banking system
stories.summary: Circle stock doubles in one month as USDC demand surges amid Hormuz disruptions and sanctions. Stablecoins becoming parallel financial infrastructure.

stories.label: 150 countries warn growth obsession destroying nature
stories.summary: Strongest collective governmental admission that economic growth model is incompatible with biodiversity survival. 150 countries issued joint warning.

stories.label: China's 15th five-year plan: climate implications
stories.summary: Carbon Brief analysis of whether China's strategic plan matches Paris Agreement pace. World's largest emitter at critical juncture.

stories.label: Why gas prices set electricity costs even in non-gas countries
stories.summary: Merit-order pricing mechanism means gas prices set marginal electricity costs even in countries barely using gas. Hormuz disruption spiking bills globally.

stories.label: OpenAI tech deployed in Iran war via Pentagon
stories.summary: MIT Tech Review examines where OpenAI tech is being used in Iran war, two weeks after Pentagon classified access agreement. Accountability gap for AI-assisted targeting.

stories.label: Ethereum Foundation mandate debate: decentralization vs retreat
stories.summary: Foundation published mandate reinforcing decentralization principles. Community split: principled step back or abdication as institutional interest grows.

stories.label: US vacating Indo-Pacific deterrence for Iran war
stories.summary: Former senior US officials warn carrier strike groups meant for Taiwan deterrence are now in Persian Gulf. South Korea, Japan, Taiwan exposed.

stories.label: Cuba island-wide blackout from Trump oil blockade
stories.summary: Cuba plunged into island-wide blackout after Trump tightened oil blockade cutting Venezuelan fuel shipments. 11 million people affected.

stories.label: France municipal elections: far right gains, Macron collapse
stories.summary: First round of French municipal elections — bellwether for 2027 presidential. Far right National Rally performance in new territory.

stories.label: Trump third-country deportations: appeal court green light
stories.summary: Appeal court rules Trump can resume deporting people to countries they have no connection to. Legal architecture for outsourcing deportees.

stories.label: US blocks China from Brazil port auction
stories.summary: US pressuring Brazil to exclude Chinese companies from its largest port auction. Great Power competition in Latin American infrastructure.

stories.label: AGOA at 30 years: African trade preferences at crossroads
stories.summary: US African Growth and Opportunity Act approaching 30 years — economies more dependent than ever as expiration/transformation looms.

stories.label: Pakistan current account surplus amid triple crisis
stories.summary: Pakistan posts $479M surplus in February — driven by import collapse, not prosperity. Remittances held steady as diaspora sends crisis money.

stories.label: T. Rowe Price puts memecoins in institutional ETF
stories.summary: $1.8T asset manager packaging dogecoin and shiba inu in regulated ETF. Memecoins entering institutional investment products.

stories.label: Crypto rebound: ETH +10% as institutional ETF demand drives recovery
stories.summary: Ether surges 10% leading crypto rebound. Institutional ETF demand driving recovery while traditional markets stay volatile from Hormuz.
